arms.baseline+F1+F6: Stop-and-wait TUNED (STUCK_TICKS=8): the stronger honesty check | F1: polyline sweep in the safety check (both arms) | F6: stall release does not hand the task back to the same robot for 30 s (engine, all arms)
arms.stop_and_wait+F1+F6: Traditional stop-and-wait (TextbookStopAndWaitPolicy, STUCK_TICKS=30): the SIH C2 comparison arm | F1: polyline sweep in the safety check (both arms) | F6: stall release does not hand the task back to the same robot for 30 s (engine, all arms)
arms.swarmos+F1+F3+F5+F6: SWARMOS product policy (graded ladder + Simplex kernel + perception fallback) | F1: polyline sweep in the safety check (both arms) | F3: leader keeps right of way in the contest band (SWARMOS ladder) | F5: standoff breaker: deterministic loser replans around the peer (SWARMOS) | F6: stall release does not hand the task back to the same robot for 30 s (engine, all arms)

command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 tools/run_experiment.py --name c2v2_pipeline_smoke --scenarios overlap_batch --arms stop_and_wait+F1+F6 baseline+F1+F6 swarmos+F1+F3+F5+F6 --reference stop_and_wait+F1+F6 --seeds 101 102 --workers 4
name: c2v2_pipeline_smoke

overlap_batch.description: The SIH C2 benchmark. Single-file aisles (the narrow_aisle_deadlock floor), pick stations on the south wall and drop stations on the north, so loaded robots travel north while empty robots return south through the same aisles: overlapping, head-on paths by construction. A fixed batch of 24 tasks for 8 robots; the run ends when all 24 are complete (cap 3000 s, reported as did-not-finish if hit).
overlap_batch.name: overlap_batch
overlap_batch.proves: Total task-completion time (makespan) versus traditional stop-and-wait on overlapping paths, with zero collisions.
overlap_batch.title: Overlapping paths, fixed batch
